scope: Viewer-local saved-pair summary/details implementation and pure tests only. No Tk root/window, actual display oracle, visual/keyboard acceptance, installed pair workflow, native physics/replay, build, full suite, WSL, browser, push, PR or integration performed for this follow-up.

environment.resource_scope: Own process lifetime peak and whole-machine sampled headroom; parent-owned acceptance may run concurrently, so these are not isolated performance claims.

pure_focused_candidate.working_state: Base commit plus prepared viewer/tests/docs changes; tested implementation is identified by file hashes above.

pure_contracts: Independent saved endpoint values and Right-minus-Left signs/units; exact set-intersection/shared-only count wording.
Explicit incompatibility/no numerical result, fixture criterion passed/failed/not-applied wording and unavailable/incomplete recipes.
Bounded escaped visible claims, complete unchanged read-only API JSON/IDs/clocks, no input byte/mtime changes.
Backend imports/processes/Tk constructors/physics/replay blocked during pair worker exercise.
Malformed/oversized input and finite subtraction overflow remain queued failures.
Matching current worker publishes and releases; stale completion releases its own ownership without publication; nonowner completion cannot release another job.
Kind reset/close clear report/details/role claims while an existing worker retains ownership; normal primary inspection controls remain available.

required_source_catalog_refresh.scope: Required stdlib AST source catalog refresh only; no simulator import or GUI.

deferred_actual_tk.syntax: Parsed with stdlib AST only; not imported, collected or executed as Tk tests.
deferred_actual_tk.contracts: Normal chooser/explicit kind, read-only Details/passivity, failed input recovery, unavailable/incompatible claims, kind/primary reset, delayed close/kind publication, parent close, four size/theme layouts and Escape/primary cursor.

acceptance_boundary: Pure success is not actual Tk, visual, genuine-record display, frozen/installed workflow or new physics acceptance. Existing desktop self-test flags and single-record scope remain unchanged. Parent owns later exact-head review and allocated gates.
retention: Raw test snapshots/helpers/receipts/logs are retained in ignored work/native-comparison-viewer; {baseline_python} is the existing ordinary project interpreter. Historical PR100/c8 and earlier provenance/static evidence are unchanged.
